test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

The new President has __bring in__ many reforms.
solution:
The correct answer is **'brought about'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined part of the given sentence *bring in *has an error in tense form. 
 
• **Bring** is the infinitive form and produces compounds with the verb *"to do".*
 
• Thus, **"has bring in"** is incorrect. 
 
• '**has**' followed by **V3** hence we will use '**brought**'.
 
• **Brought** is the past tense and forms compound forms with the verb ***"to have"***. 
 
• **Brought about'** is a phrasal verb which means ***to cause to happen : accomplish.***
 
• This phrase is contextually and grammatically correct for the given sentence.
 
• So, the correct replacement for the underlined part is **brought about**. 
 
• Hence, **option 2 **is the correct answer. 

**Correct sentence__ - ***The new President has **__brought about__** many reforms.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__***

 
• ** brought out**:* *to expose, reveal, or cause to be seen.
